description: This lot includes three unpolished mineral specimens in raw condition. The first is a green, semi-translucent stone with natural fractures and brownish inclusions, possibly green jasper or aventurine. The second is a large blocky piece with beige to light grey tones and reddish-grey streaks, identified as a type of jasper or chert. The third specimen is a dark purple stone with cream and tan inclusions, resembling raw lepidolite or sugilite. All pieces feature natural surfaces and edges. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or lapidary projects.
